summary: Procure AnnotatorX Enterprise: VPC-hosted seats, SCIM/Okta provisioning, BYOK KMS
description:
Issue summary:
Data Platform requests procurement of AnnotatorX Enterprise (annotation platform) for dataset labeling and model eval pipelines. Requirement is VPC-hosted/private deployment with SCIM/Okta provisioning, BYOK KMS support, and a pooled seat model for contractors and internal teams.

Impact:
- Data labeling work for two active RLHF projects is blocked pending access to annotation tooling.
- Expected delay in upcoming model evals (~2 sprint impact) if not provisioned within 3 weeks.

Environment:
- Target production: VPC deployment in us-west (customer-managed VPC peering).
- Staging: vendor-managed instance in us-east for testing.
- Okta (SSO) already in use across Redwood.

Requirements checklist:
1) 120 seats initial purchase, with 40-seat contractor burst pool and SCIM group mapping.
2) Vendor must support private VPC deployment (no public egress) and BYOK integration with AWS KMS/HSM.
3) SCIM provisioning + Okta group sync (groups: datalabelers, rl-research, contractors).
4) SOC2/ISO27001 evidence and a short network diagram for security review.
5) Annual renewal option and PO/contract aligned to Redwood fiscal center 4300.

Steps to provision / To reproduce the gating:
1) Procurement to accept vendor quote and issue PO.
2) Security to approve network diagram and BYOK posture.
3) Okta team to enable SCIM connection and map groups.
4) Vendor to deploy VPC instance and provide admin console access.
5) Data Platform to validate with 5 test users and confirm data residency settings.

Attachments / Links:
- Vendor quote (AnnotatorX_Quote_2026-03-10.pdf) in procurement drive.
- Security questionnaire responses: link to Confluence (see related_confluence_pages).
procurement_details: Requested 120 seats with 12-month term, contractor burst pool of 40 seats, annual invoicing. Vendor provided enterprise quote with BYOK add-on and VPC deployment fee.
investigation_notes: 2026-03-12: Confirmed vendor supports KMS BYOK; vendor requires KMS key policy to allow AnnotatorX service principal.
2026-03-13: Network team recommends VPC peering rather than open internet egress; vendor prefers single IP allowlist for admin callbacks (security to review).
2026-03-14: Okta team needs SCIM endpoint cert SAN to match internal PKI; vendor to provide cert rotation plan.

resolution: Provisioning in progress; PO issued and security approval received with TLS cert condition. Infra PR opened and Okta SCIM mapping pending cert. Expected completion: 2026-03-21.
resolution_notes: Once vendor deploys VPC and provides admin cert, Okta team will finish SCIM sync and Procurement will finalize annual contract. Post-provisioning actions: create runbook for seat allocation and contractor burst process; schedule quarterly audit evidence refresh.
follow_up_tasks: Finalize contract signature and archive vendor security intake
Complete infra peering and test tunnel health checks
Okta SCIM: map groups and verify 5 test accounts
Create internal runbook for contractor seat allocation
